title: Speed up Script comparisons in `ContainerTypeValidate` and `GDScript::set`
body:

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Speeds up script comparisons used in type checks
    - Typed `Array` and `Dictionary`
    - Typed GDScript::set

## Additional information

The main change is changing the return type of `ScriptInstance::get_script` from `Ref<Script>` to `Script *`. Most of the diffs are updating the overrides or fixing callsites. Generally I tried to keep the old code the same, wrapping in a `Ref` except in very simple cases. 

Note I did not change some lines that did not encounter compilation errors. For example `...get_script()->get_path()` would get the benefit of not going through Ref. 

In addition to the refactor, two other files have been changed for performance benefit:
* `container_type_validate.cpp`
* `gdscript_function.cpp`

## Benchmarks

Project: [script-type-checks.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32626656/script-type-checks.zip)

<details>
<summary>Benchmark setup</summary>

A.gd
```gdscript
class_name A extends Object

var x: A
```

### `GDScript::set`

```gdscript
var a := A.new()
var x := A.new()

for i in 50_000_000:
	a.x = x
```

### `Dictionary::has`

```gdscript
var d : Dictionary[A, int]
var a := A.new()

for i in 20_000_000:
	d.has(a)
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>Specs and test setup</summary>
CPU: AMD 9800X3D, GPU: AMD RX 6800, RAM: 32GB 6400 CL28

Windows 11, Release templates built with GCC (MinGW)

Each case was run twice per project opening. Both versions (PR/Master) were opened 7 times and the 14 results were aggregated by 20th percentile. 
</details>

| Scenario | Master (ns/op) | PR (ns/op) | Diff | Speedup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GDScriptInstance set | 30.8 | 16.0 | -14.8 | 1.92x |
| Dictionary has() | 86.7 | 29.0 | -57.7 | 2.99x |

## Future Work

* Apply same change to `Script::get_base_script`
* Tackle other callsites of `Object::get_script`
